mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `project_reject` WHERE DATE_FORMAT(#{date}, '%Y%m%d') = DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y%m%d')

select a.* from project_reject a LEFT JOIN contract_project cp ON cp.id = a.project_id AND cp.bool_delete_enum = FALSE where a.bool_delete_enum = 0
and DATE_FORMAT(a.create_time,'%Y-%m-%d') >= DATE_FORMAT(#{createTime[0]},'%Y-%m-%d')
and DATE_FORMAT(a.create_time,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{createTime[1]},'%Y-%m-%d')
and a.review_status = #{reviewStatus}
and a.product_type & #{productType} > 0
and (cp.name like concat('%',#{projectName},'%') or cp.short_name like concat('%',#{projectName},'%') or cp.serial_number like concat('%',#{projectName},'%'))
and a.serial_number like concat('%',#{serialNumber},'%')
and a.reviewer_name like concat('%',#{reviewerName},'%')
and a.applicant_name like concat('%',#{applicantName},'%')
AND a.project_id in
#{projectId}
order by CASE a.review_status WHEN 16 THEN 1 WHEN 2 THEN 2 WHEN 4 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, a.id DESC
